⚠ PLEASE DON'T DISCLOSE SECURITY-RELATED ISSUES PUBLICLY, SEE BELOW.

If you have found a security issue in Kekos Http Emitter, please open [a security
vulnerability using GitHub](https://github.com/Kekos/http-emitter/security/advisories/new)
and don't disclose it publicly until we can provide a fix for it.
